statements.text: Assessment: left lumbar radiculopathy at L4-L5 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
MRI lumbar spine 07/30/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Reports low back pain radiating to the left leg for 16 weeks.
PT discharge summary: completed 4 weeks of physical therapy (05/27/2026 to 06/24/2026) without meaningful improvement; meloxicam 15 mg daily for the same period without relief.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Denies fever, chills, weight loss, or bowel or bladder changes; no history of cancer.
Epidural steroid injection history: 2 lumbar injections in the past 12 months (04/05/2026, 07/01/2026).
